thesis: Four routes, and a real spread between them. The capacity market at four hours is the best design here, at 14.6% hold; MACSE's fifteen-year contract returns 2.5–3% unless the marginal MWh costs well under the turnkey price. Terna's proposed cut to the four-hour de-rating is the risk to watch.
四条路径并存，且彼此之间差距真实存在。四小时容量市场是这里的最佳设计，持有期回报14.6%；MACSE的十五年合同回报仅2.5–3%，除非边际MWh成本远低于交钥匙价格。需要关注的风险是Terna拟下调四小时折减系数。

why: MACSE pays per MWh-year, so winners build long (the first auction's fleet averaged 6.68 hours), but on the published capex the design returns 2.5–3% hold.
MACSE按每MWh每年付费，因此中标者倾向长时设计（首轮中标项目平均6.68小时），但按公开的资本开支测算，该设计持有期回报仅2.5–3%。

text: Get an EPC price for a marginal MWh on a shared power block before the second auction; the MACSE design pays only well below the €220/kWh turnkey figure.
在第二轮拍卖前向EPC询价共享功率模块上的边际MWh；只有远低于每kWh 220欧元的交钥匙价格，MACSE设计才划算。
On the published €220/kWh capex the MACSE design returns 2.5–3% hold at six to eight hours.
按公开的每kWh 220欧元资本开支测算，MACSE设计在六至八小时下的持有期回报为2.5–3%。
An award is a fifteen-year contract with the grid operator and secures about 70% of revenue.
中标即获得与电网运营商的十五年合同，可锁定约70%的收入。

despite: The first auction's winners built 6.68 hours on average, so they price the marginal MWh below the published turnkey figure; at that cost the case changes.
首轮中标项目平均为6.68小时，说明其边际MWh成本低于公开的交钥匙价格；按那样的成本，结论会改变。
